Zoe Park: Heads up — MapleBridge (acct MB-301) INV-5402 for $11,760 is 25 days overdue. AM says they're asking for an escrow hold while their procurement completes PO approval.
Marcus Lee: Any failed payment attempts recorded?
Talia Burns: No failed CC or ACH. Their billing contact said treasury is out until next week, hence the delay. They asked if we can put the invoice into escrow and not suspend service.
Zoe Park: Our standard is no escrow holds, but we can offer a short payment plan or a temp grace with proof of procurement timeline. Collections, what's recommended?
CollectionsBot: Typical options: 1) 14-day grace with signed commitment, 2) 2-installment split (50/50) with first payment within 7 days, 3) suspend after final notice.
Marcus Lee: Recommend 50/50 split: $5,880 due in 7 days, remainder in 30 days. Require signed acknowledgement from Procurement. If they miss the first payment, we suspend immediately.
Talia Burns: LegalOps — do we need an addendum for that?
LegalOps: A simple payment agreement email from their procurement team is sufficient for a one-off split. If they request escrow, we need CFO-level sign-off + exec approval from Revenue Ops.
Zoe Park: Ok — @Marcus please ask AM to get Procurement to sign the commitment and collect the first payment. I'll offer a one-time courtesy to keep services running.
Marcus Lee: Noted. AM reached out to procurement at 11:12, asked for signed ack and wire instructions. AM will update by EOD tomorrow.
CollectionsBot: Pausing automated dunning sequence for MB-301 pending collection of first installment (paused by Zoe Park at 2024-08-03 14:05:02).
Talia Burns: Ledger note: if payment received, apply to INV-5402 and mark partial-paid. If not received by 7 days, resume sequence and schedule suspension.
Zoe Park: I'll check back in 48h. If AM doesn't secure commitment, we proceed with suspension notice.
